column1: # CD1 "Vasos de Barro" track manifest: number, slug, exact audio filename.
# Both albums keep their MP3s in the repo root with the same NN prefixes
# (CD2/Peregrino titles are ALL CAPS, CD1 titles are Title Case), so a
# glob like "07 *.mp3" is ambiguous — always resolve through this file.
# Filenames are stored NFC-normalized; on disk they are decomposed, so
# match with a glob or normalize before comparing.
